tellings.quote: I spoke to how put off who ran the Stargate the psychic fire program for the CIA

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels, who interviews people about UFOs and strange experiences, says he once spoke with Hal Puthoff, whom he describes as the man who ran Stargate, a CIA programme that tried to use psychics for spying. Michels raised this in a 2024 episode with Eric Wargo, a writer on prophetic dreams, while talking about the idea that people might sense the future before it happens. If that idea held, it would mean the mind can reach forward in time.
